title: Artificial intelligence in neuropathology: deep learning-based assessment of tauopathy

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence in neuropathology: deep learning-based assessment of tauopathy》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Accumulation of abnormal tau in neurofibrillary tangles (NFT) occurs in Alzheimer disease (AD) and a spectrum of tauopathies.

evidence.text: Accumulation of abnormal tau in neurofibrillary tangles (NFT) occurs in Alzheimer disease (AD) and a spectrum of tauopathies.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】The histopathological material was derived from 22 autopsy brains from patients with tauopathies.

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】With our FCN model, we achieved high precision and recall in naive WSI semantic segmentation, correctly identifying tangle objects using a SegNet model trained for 200 epochs.

evidence.text: The histopathological material was derived from 22 autopsy brains from patients with tauopathies.
With our FCN model, we achieved high precision and recall in naive WSI semantic segmentation, correctly identifying tangle objects using a SegNet model trained for 200 epochs.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence in neuropathology: deep learning-based assessment of tauopathy》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】We found that the deep learning framework is capable of identifying and quantifying NFT with a range of staining intensities and diverse morphologies.

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】With our FCN model, we achieved high precision and recall in naive WSI semantic segmentation, correctly identifying tangle objects using a SegNet model trained for 200 epochs.

evidence.text: We found that the deep learning framework is capable of identifying and quantifying NFT with a range of staining intensities and diverse morphologies.
With our FCN model, we achieved high precision and recall in naive WSI semantic segmentation, correctly identifying tangle objects using a SegNet model trained for 200 epochs.
